subject: S06 CI fix (1508098): learn.spec green on webkit, chromium and firefox in run 43987646921 (66/66 each)
body:
Cause: in CI run 43980155054, learn.spec.ts:357 failed on webkit-desktop-1920 with 'pageerror: .../api/public-config due to access control checks'. A public-config (ui_copy) fetch was still open when the test navigated to the next error page, and WebKit reports a request cut off that way as an error.

Fix: quiet() in learn.spec now also waits until no request to the app's own /api is open. Requests are tracked per page from its first navigation. This sits alongside settle() and data-learn-idle; no timeouts were added.

Gate: the full CI-equivalent gate passed (lint, typecheck, vitest web 254 / ui 27 / shared 125 / ink 66, pytest unit 822, contract and requirements drift clean, build).

Local, --retries=0: learn.spec on webkit-desktop-1920, webkit-phone-390, webkit-ipad-portrait, firefox-phone-412 and chromium-laptop-1440 with --repeat-each=2: 110/110 passed, after reseeding a fresh stack.

CI run https://github.com/arrowassassin/naadi/actions/runs/43987646921 (head 1508098):
- e2e (webkit): success.
- e2e (firefox): success.
- e2e (chromium): failure, but learn.spec passed 66/66 there. The 12 failures are all in ink-sync.spec.ts:290 and :365 (S12a), the same tests that failed in 43980155054.
- learn.spec passed 66/66 in each of the three browsers.
- integration and lint/build: success.
